_comment: OPTIONAL: attach keyhole serve to Claude Code. Merge mcpServers into your project's .mcp.json. Replace <ABSOLUTE PATH> with this repo's absolute path and ks-XXXX with the session id that keyhole wrap prints. The command is node, never npm run: npm's banner would corrupt the MCP stdio channel. The session key comes from KEYHOLE_SESSION_KEY or the session's keychain file; serve loads no other key.
